services.name: Serviced RV Sites
services.desc: Our resort, nestled within the Selkirk Mountains, 35 km East of Revelstoke, is home to over 100 private campsites, perfect for tenting and RV-ing. Enjoy the calming forest air and the sounds of the nearby mountain stream from your site, or reserve the private section of the campground for your wedding or family reunion. Pitch your tent and relax among the old-growth trees in our campsites. These sites are perfect for friends and families searching for a quiet getaway in the mountains, reunions or the basecamp for your next adventure in Revelstoke. One tent and one vehicle per site. Campsites don’t include power or water hookups. Firewood is available for purchase. Let the open road guide

services.name: Cabins & Lodges
services.desc: Experience the best of rustic BC hospitality in our signature cabin and chalet accommodations, situated in the heart of the stunning Selkirk Mountains. Our cabins are beautifully furnished and private for your absolute comfort. Perfect for families or couples searching for a romantic retreat, the Grizzly Lodge features a jacuzzi tub and a spacious two storey layout that’ll make you feel right at home. In the Grizzly Lodge you will find a queen size bed with a kitchen and a full bathroom and on the top floor you will find a queen size bed, double bed, jacuzzi tub, and half bathroom.
